summary: This section explains the official date of a resolution passed during an adjourned meeting. It ensures that the resolution is treated as passed on the actual day the meeting took place, rather than any earlier date. This rule applies to meetings held by a company, a specific class of shareholders, or the Board of Directors.
points: Applies to resolutions passed at an adjourned meeting of a company, shareholders of a specific class, or the Board of Directors.
Treats the resolution as passed on the actual date it was passed.
Forbids treating the resolution as if it was passed on any earlier date.
example: Meera Textiles Private Limited held a board meeting last week, but it had to be adjourned because not enough directors were present. The adjourned meeting was then successfully held yesterday, and the board voted to approve a new contract. According to the law, the resolution to approve this contract is officially treated as passed yesterday, which is the actual day of the adjourned meeting. It cannot be backdated to the day the original meeting first started.

terms.meaning: A meeting that was paused and postponed to be continued at a later date.
A formal decision or vote made by a group during a meeting.

watch: Do not assume the resolution takes effect from the date the original meeting first began.
